scope: Game-only H1 update of Texas Hold'em 1.1.0 with host-authoritative CPU players on both recorded Waveshare 4.3 consoles; no Console OS partition, firmware, bootloader, partition table, OTA data, NVS, save data, or unrelated microSD file was written.

cpu_modes: local four-seat table with zero to three CPU seats
network table with connected human slots plus host-controlled CPU seats up to four total

installation.method: validated atomic P4G upload through each running console's recorded H1 port with native catalog hot reload
installation.device_activation: fsync plus complete package and payload double-validation

cpu_behavior.authority: local runtime offline; network host only when linked
cpu_behavior.seat_assignment: highest local seat numbers or contiguous seats after connected network humans
cpu_behavior.card_ui_privacy: CPU hole cards remain face-down until a non-folded showdown

operator_checklist: Open Games/Arcade and launch Texas Holdem on each unit; confirm CPU Players appears beneath Start Chips.
In local play, select one to three CPUs, deal, and confirm CPU-labeled seats act automatically after a short pause.
Confirm CPU hole cards remain face-down before showdown and the human pass/reveal overlay still protects human hands.
Use Multiplayer Host/Join with both consoles, set CPU Players to 2 on the host, and confirm the peer shows four total seats with C3 and C4 controlled by the host.
Exercise at least one complete synchronized betting round, tones, touch or controller input, and Back-to-launcher on both panels.
